text:
Maria Chen: quick UX check — I pushed a small prototype for the notify-map hover in Alerting > Channels. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/example/notify-map-hover Devin Patel: looked. main problem on narrow widths: legend overlaps the channel chips. :eyes: Maria Chen: yea. on mobile-ish widths the legend floats over thresholds. thinking a compact legend toggle or move it to a top row. Leo Rivers: keyboard nav is also borked — if you tab into a channel chip the hover preview never shows, only on mouseenter. we need focus handling + aria-describedby. Ashit Kapoor: microcopy nit: the hover header currently says "Alert: p99 > 200ms". suggest "When p99 exceeds 200ms" — clearer English and better for screen readers. Devin Patel: agreed on the copy. also accessibility: green/teal map fills for "ok" vs "degraded" have low contrast against white. I ran a quick check, contrast ratio ~2.7:1 for small text. DesignBot: automated-a11y-check: 1976543210 — contrast fail on token "ok (green)"; recommended #006644 or darker variants. Report: https://ci.internal/a11y/1976543210 Maria Chen: good catch. Devin, can you paste the new hex pair you prefer? also thinking the legend should indicate keyboard hint (e.g., "Press Enter to open preview"). Devin Patel: try these: ok: #00784D, degraded: #FF8A00, critical: #D32F2F. they hit 4.5:1 for 14px text. also reduce chip padding by 6px to avoid wrap. Leo Rivers: for focus, add tabindex=0 on the channel chip and show the same tooltip used on hover. tooltip should use role="tooltip" and connect with aria-describedby. sample: ```
...
Channel: #pagerduty · last tested 3m ago
``` Maria Chen: love the snippet. can we keep the tooltip visible for 300ms after blur to avoid flicker when keyboard users move around? Ashit Kapoor: +1 on timing. Also copy suggestion for the small timestamp: use "tested 3m ago" instead of "3 minutes ago" to keep the preview compact. Devin Patel: small UX trade: sticky legend vs collapsing. sticky legend eats vertical space in narrow dashboards. proposed compromise: collapse into a single icon with "i" that opens a short panel. Maria Chen: hmm — users need to scan legend quickly during incidents. collapsible icon adds a click. maybe default to expanded on desktop and collapsed on <=720px. Leo Rivers: implementable. we should also ensure legend items have clear focus outlines for keyboard users. don't rely on color alone — add icon shapes (stripe, dot, dash) next to colors. Maria Chen: action items: Devin - update palette + chip padding; Leo - implement keyboard tooltip + focus outline; Ashit - finalize copy for hover header + timestamp; I'll update the figma and iterate on collapsed-legend breakpoint. I'll ping when updated. :thumbsup: DesignBot: noted. created ticket: design/1976543210 — "notify map: hover & legend accessibility". ETA initial PR: 1976543295. https://tickets.internal/1976543210 Devin Patel: will start on palette now. thanks! Maria Chen: thanks all — landing this in next patch."
